name: anim_create
title: anim.create
description:
Create an animation (group + optional direction) with empty frames of equal duration.

(group, direction) must be unique (I6). Names are lower-case a-z 0-9 _ - up to 48 characters; leave direction out for an undirected animation. Frames have no keys or cels: pose them with rig_set_pose, draw into them, or add more with frame_add. For a flipped copy of a side animation use rig_mirror_animation.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (A 4-frame side run loop at 100 ms): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","group":"run","direction":"side","frames":4}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

durationMs.description: Duration of every frame in ms (default 100).

angleQuantum.description: Rig angle quantum, deg (a multiple of 0.25 that divides 360; default 1).

animation.description: Animation id.

name: anim_update
title: anim.update
description:
Rename an animation (group, direction), set its loop mode, angle quantum or post-passes.

(group, direction) must stay unique (I6). Renaming the group of a source animation renames its mirrors too (a mirror shares its source's group); a mirror's group cannot be changed on its own. Loop, angleQuantum and postPasses belong to the source: a mirror has none. null clears direction, angleQuantum or postPasses. Frame durations, markers and events: frame_set_meta.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Make the hero idle a ping-pong): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","animation":{"group":"default"},"loop":"pingpong"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

direction.description: New direction; null makes it undirected.

angleQuantum.description: Rig angle quantum, deg (multiple of 0.25 dividing 360); null restores the default.

postPasses.description: Post-passes after the rig render: {removeOrphans: {}, outline: {color: [r,g,b,a], outsideOnly?, corners?}}; null removes them.

animation.description: Animation id.

changed.description: Fields that changed; empty when nothing did.

mirrors.description: Labels of the mirror animations renamed with it.

name: cel_link
title: cel.link
description:
Link a layer's cel to another frame's cel (mode "link"), make a linked cel independent ("unlink"), or link all identical cels ("linkIdentical").

A linked cel shows the same pixels as its target; links cross animations, one hop (linking to a link links to its target). "link": animation, frame (the cel that becomes the link), source.frame (source.animation defaults to animation). "unlink" copies the pixels into the cel. "linkIdentical" links, per layer, every cel with identical pixels, offset and opacity to the first in document order.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Link the hero layer cels that have identical pixels): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","layer":"body","mode":"linkIdentical"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: link/unlink: animation of the cel. linkIdentical: limits the scan (default: all).

source.description: link: the frame whose cel is shown.

animation.description: Animation of the source frame (default: animation).

changed.description: Cels that were linked or unlinked (0 for a no-op).

imagesDeleted.description: Images that nothing used any more.

name: doc_create
title: doc.create
description:
Create a new empty RGBA document (no layers, no animations) and open it. Save it with doc_save.

The origin defaults to the bottom-centre pixel of the canvas (where the feet go). Import art with import_file, add animations with anim_create, or apply a skeleton with rig_apply_template. Use doc_set_color_mode for indexed colour.

Reads or writes files through the host. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (A 48x48 canvas): {"name":"hero","width":48,"height":48}

origin.description: Origin pixel on the canvas, int px (default: bottom-centre).

idSeed.description: Seed of the id generator (default: derived from the host clock).

doc.description: Document id for the other ops.

name: doc_open
title: doc.open
description:
Open a .pxf file and return its document id, which every other op takes as "doc".

Opening a file that is already open returns the same id (alreadyOpen: true) without re-reading it. Follow with doc_summary to see layers, rig and animations.

Reads or writes files through the host. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Open the synthetic hero): {"path":"/work/hero.pxf"}

path.description: Path of the .pxf file (absolute, inside the workspace roots).

doc.description: Document id for the other ops.

alreadyOpen.description: True when the file was open already.

warnings.description: Problems found while reading (e.g. a dropped render cache).

name: redo
title: doc.redo
description:
Redo the newest undone change of the document (one history entry).

Re-applies the entry that the last doc.undo reverted. A new change clears the redo entries. Nothing to redo is not an error: redone is false.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Redo on a fresh open (nothing to redo)): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

redone.description: True when an entry was re-applied; false when there was nothing to redo.

label.description: Label of the re-applied entry (for example "AI: rig.setPose"); null when nothing was redone.

name: doc_save
title: doc.save
description:
Save the document to its .pxf file, or to a new path (first save, save as).

The path must be inside the workspace roots. Writes a temp file in the same folder and renames it over the target, so a crash never leaves a torn file. A new path takes the document's lock first (DOC_LOCKED if another process owns it) and releases the old one. An existing file at a new path is refused unless overwrite is true. Saving an unchanged, already saved document writes nothing.

Reads or writes files through the host. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Save the hero under a new name): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","path":"/work/hero-v2.pxf"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

path.description: Target .pxf path (absolute, inside the workspace roots). Default: the current path.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at a new path (default false).

wrote.description: False when the document was unchanged and nothing was written.

bytes.description: Size of the file written, bytes (0 when nothing was written).

name: doc_set_color_mode
title: doc.setColorMode
description:
Switch the document between "rgba" and "indexed" pixels, and/or lock it to its palette.

Converting is exact: to "indexed" every colour must be an entry of the active palette (the first alpha-0 entry is the transparent index), else the call is refused and nothing changes; to "rgba" indices resolve through the palette. Both need an active palette. The lock does not recolour: lint (palette.offPalette) judges the render.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Lock a document that has a palette to it): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","paletteLocked":true}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

paletteLocked.description: Lock colours to the active palette (default: unchanged).

name: doc_summary
title: doc.summary
description:
Summarise an open document: canvas, palette, layers, rig (bones, parts, views) and animations.

Names in the result (bones, parts, layers, animation group/direction) are what the other ops take as references.

Read-only. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Summarise the hero): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".
Document id.

path.description: Backing file, null for an unsaved document.

version.description: Runtime version: +1 per change, undo and redo.

dirty.description: Changed (or undone/redone) since it was opened or last saved.

origin.description: Anchor pixel shared with the engine (mirroring flips about origin.x).

palette.description: The active palette, null when there is none.

path.description: Names from the root, joined by "/".

layers.description: Every layer, depth first, bottom to top.

name.description: Part-layer name: how ops address the part.

rig.description: Null when the document has no rig.

frames.description: Frame count (the source animation for a mirror).

mirrorOf.description: Label of the source animation of a mirror.

name: undo
title: doc.undo
description:
Undo the newest applied change of the document (one history entry).

Reverts the last applied history entry, whatever op made it. Nothing to undo is not an error: undone is false. Re-apply with doc.redo.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Undo the last change of the hero (nothing to undo on a fresh open)): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

undone.description: True when an entry was reverted; false when there was nothing to undo.

label.description: Label of the reverted entry (for example "AI: rig.setPose"); null when nothing was undone.

name: frame_add
title: frame.add
description:
Insert an empty frame before or after a frame; the new frame gets no bone or part keys.

The new frame has no keys, so bones and parts interpolate into it from the neighbouring keys. Cels and overrides are not copied (use frame.duplicate to copy them). Set its keys with rig.setPose.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Add an empty frame after frame 0 of the hero): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","animation":{"group":"default"},"frame":0}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

frame.description: Reference frame: the new frame goes next to it.

position.description: "after" (default) inserts behind the reference frame, "before" in front of it.

durationMs.description: Duration of the new frame in ms (default: the reference frame duration).

frameIndex.description: Index of the new frame in the animation.

frames.description: Frame count of the animation afterwards.

name: frame_delete
title: frame.delete
description:
Delete one frame with its bone and part keys, cels and overrides; the last frame cannot go.

Links to the frame cels are materialised first: the other linked frames keep their picture as their own copy. Images nothing references any more are removed. An animation keeps at least one frame.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Delete frame 1 of the hero (add a second frame first; the hero has one)): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","animation":{"group":"default"},"frame":1}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

frames.description: Frame count of the animation afterwards.

name: frame_duplicate
title: frame.duplicate
description:
Duplicate one frame; the copy goes right after it, with linked cels and copied keys.

Cels of the copy link to the source frame (edit one, both change). Bone keys, part keys, markers, events, root motion, duration and overrides are copied.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Duplicate frame 0 of the hero): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","animation":{"group":"default"},"frame":0}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

frameIndex.description: Index of the new frame (source index + 1).

frames.description: Frame count of the animation afterwards.

name: frame_set_meta
title: frame.setMeta
description:
Set one frame's duration (ms), markers (name -> int px), events (names) and root motion (int px).

Only the fields you give change. markers merge by name (null removes one); events replace the whole list; rootMotion is the move the game applies when this frame is played (int px, y down). New marker and event names are added to the document's markerDefs / eventDefs. Mirror animations have no frames: edit the source.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Hold the hero frame 200 ms and fire a footstep event): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","animation":{"group":"default"},"frame":0,"durationMs":200,"events":["footstep"]}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

markers.description: Markers by name, canvas px (e.g. "hand_r": {"x": 30, "y": 20}); null removes one.

events.description: Event names fired on this frame; replaces the list.

rootMotion.description: Root motion of this frame, int px.

animation.description: "group/direction" of the animation.

changed.description: Fields that changed; empty when nothing did.

name: export
title: io.export
description:
Export animations as a spritesheet PNG plus a JSON description (Aseprite hash format).

Renders every frame like the game would see it (export layers only; rig, overrides and post-passes applied; mirrors flipped) and writes <name>.png and <name>.json next to each other, atomically. layout "rows" puts one animation per row; "packed" fills a near-square grid. scale is an integer 1..16. The JSON lists a frame per cell with its duration, and one tag per animation ("group" or "group/direction").

Reads or writes files through the host. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Export the hero as a 2x sheet): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","path":"/work/out/hero.png","scale":2}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

path.description: Output PNG path (absolute, inside the workspace roots); the JSON goes beside it.

animations.description: Animations to export, in order (default: all).

items.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

exportOnly.description: Only layers with export: true (default true).

name: import_file
title: io.import
description:
Import a PNG spritesheet (cells per animation) or an .aseprite file into a document.

Format is guessed from the extension. Spritesheet: animations maps cells to animations; repeated cells become linked cels; the cell's bottom-centre lands on the document origin. Aseprite: adds layers, tags (as animations) and the palette; the canvas must equal the document's. A failed import changes nothing.

Reads or writes files through the host. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Cut row 0, columns 0 to 2 of a 64x64 sheet into move_gather at 12 fps): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","file":"/work/run.png","cell":[64,64],"animations":[{"group":"move_gather","cells":[{"row":0,"col":"0-2"}],"fps":12}]}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

file.description: Path of the file (absolute, inside the workspace roots).

cell.description: spritesheet: cell size [w, h] px (default: the whole image is one cell).

animations.description: spritesheet: the animations to cut (required for a spritesheet).

row.description: Row (0-based, row 0 on top), or a range "from-to".

cells.description: Cells in play order: [row, col], or {"row": 4, "col": "3-6"} for row 4, columns 3 to 6.

outlineFile.description: spritesheet: matching outline sheet, same size.

layerName.description: spritesheet: layer for the cels (default "body"; reused if it exists).

outlineLayerName.description: spritesheet: layer of the outline sheet (default "outline").

defaultDurationMs.description: spritesheet: frame duration when an animation gives none (default 100).

reimport.description: aseprite: update a file imported earlier instead of adding (default false).

view.description: aseprite: rig view for "part:" layers without #view (default: the first).

paletteName.description: aseprite: name of the imported palette.

frames.description: Frames created (re-import: frames in the file).

parts.description: aseprite: "part:" layers bound, updated (re-import) or left as pixel layers.

name: layer_update
title: layer.update
description:
Rename a layer, or set its visible flag, opacity (0..255) or export flag.

Only the fields you give change. Names are lower-case a-z 0-9 _ - up to 48 characters and unique among siblings; a part layer's name is the part's name and must be unique in the whole document. A reference layer is never exported. Hidden or non-exported layers are skipped by the export render (io_export, lint, bake).

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Hide the hero's head part from the editor render): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","layer":"head","visible":false}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

visible.description: Show or hide the layer in the editor render.

export.description: Include the layer in exports and bakes.

path.description: Name path from the root afterwards (e.g. "body/arm").

changed.description: Fields that changed; empty when nothing did.

name: lint
title: lint.run
description:
Check the document and list findings (palette, orphan pixels, joint gaps, stale overrides, empty frames).

Read-only. Frames are rendered and checked; findings come sorted by rule, then document order. Narrow the check with enable, disable, animations or skins. Severity "error" means an invariant is broken; fix warnings before a delivery.

Read-only. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Lint the hero, joint and palette rules only): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","enable":["rig.jointGap","palette.offPalette"]}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

enable.description: Run only these rule ids (default: all).

disable.description: Skip these rule ids (applied after enable).

animations.description: Animations to render and check (default: all, in document order).

items.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

skins.description: Skin names to render for palette checks; "base" is the base colours (default: base, then every skin).

severity.description: "error" breaks an invariant, "warning" should be fixed, "info" may be intended.

location.description: Where the finding is; a rule fills the fields that apply.

data.description: Machine-readable details; keys per rule are in packages/lint/README.md.

name: override_list
title: override.list
description:
List overrides: stale ones (art under them changed) and ones that fail to render, apart.

Read-only; renders the frames that have overrides. "stale" overrides are still applied; decide with override_resolve (keep, rebase = accept the current art, discard). "errors" cannot be judged because their frame does not render (missing image, no view for the direction...): fix the rig first, they cannot be rebased until it renders. Part overrides of mirror animations are never rendered and not listed.

Read-only. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (List the hero overrides): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

items.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

animation.description: "group/direction" of the animation owning it.

frameIndex.description: Frame index in the animation (the source's for a mirror).

target.description: "final" (whole composite) or the part layer name.

mirror.description: True for a mirror animation's own final override.

reason.description: "hash": the pixels under it changed; "no-target": nothing to compare with (hidden part, deleted frame); "error": it could not be rendered.

animation.description: "group/direction" of the animation owning it.

frameIndex.description: Frame index in the animation (the source's for a mirror).

target.description: "final" (whole composite) or the part layer name.

mirror.description: True for a mirror animation's own final override.

reason.description: "hash": the pixels under it changed; "no-target": nothing to compare with (hidden part, deleted frame); "error": it could not be rendered.

valid.description: Ids of the overrides that are up to date.

name: override_resolve
title: override.resolve
description:
Resolve overrides: "keep" them, "rebase" onto the current art, or "discard" them.

Name overrides by id (from override_list) or pass allStale: true for every stale one. "keep" changes nothing (a stale override is still applied) and just confirms the ids exist. "rebase" accepts the art under the override as the new base, so it stops being stale; it needs the frame to render. "discard" deletes the override and its pixels. With allStale, overrides that fail to render are left out of a rebase and reported in skipped.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Re-base every stale override after reviewing the render): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","action":"rebase","allStale":true}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

allStale.description: Also include every stale override of the document (default false).

resolved.description: Override ids the action applied to.

skipped.description: allStale rebase: ids left out because they fail to render.

name: part_paint_overlap
title: part.paintOverlap
description:
Close joint gaps by painting hidden overlap on the part drawn lower; the rest composite does not change.

For each joint with gaps (rig_joint_check), paints only pixels the upper part covers at rest, growing the variant image and shifting its pivot to keep the part in place. The colour is the variant's most frequent opaque one unless you pass color ([r,g,b,a], or a palette index when indexed). "uncovered" lists joints no hidden paint can close (they need a visible art change); "skipped" joints with several parts per bone or a part rotated at rest. Re-run rig_joint_check.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Close the elbow gap of the hero): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","bones":["lower_arm_r"]}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

view.description: Rig view to check (default: the first view).

bones.description: Only joints whose child bone is one of these (default: all joints with gaps).

color.description: Paint colour: [r,g,b,a], or a palette index in an indexed document.

bones.description: Child bones of the joints it serves.

grew.description: Pixels the variant image grew on each side.

painted.description: Variants that were painted (empty when no joint has gaps).

uncovered.description: Joints with gap pixels no hidden paint can close.

name: part_split
title: part.split
description:
Split a region (rect, lasso or flood) of a flat layer's cel into a new layer bound to a bone.

The pixels move into a new layer; the remainder plus the parts recomposite the frame. partName ("part:upper_arm_r", "part:hand_r@open#side": variant, view) binds it, else it binds by overlap if there is a clear winner, or stays a pixel layer (see ambiguous/skipped). The part draws in every frame: hide it elsewhere (rig_set_pose visible=false).

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Cut the head rectangle of a flat run frame into the head part): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","layer":"body","animation":{"group":"run"},"frame":0,"selection":{"kind":"rect","x":24,"y":16,"w":18,"h":12},"partName":"part:head"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

layer.description: The flat pixel layer to cut from (id or name).

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

frame.description: The frame whose cel is cut.

points.description: Closed polygon through canvas pixels [[x, y], ...] (the last joins the first).

boundary.description: Colours ([r,g,b,a], or palette indices) that stop the flood; default: only the seed colour.

includeBoundary.description: Also take the boundary-coloured pixels touching the region (an outline).

partName.description: Bind as "part:<bone>[.<part>][@variant][#view]" or a bone name.

name.description: Name of the new layer while it is not a part (default "split").

bind.description: Without partName: try to bind by overlap (default true).

view.description: View for names without #view and for overlap (default: the first).

zByBone.description: Default z of the new part by part-layer name, then bone name; higher draws on top.

layer.description: Layer holding the moved pixels (the part layer once bound).

image.description: Image id of the moved pixels.

bounds.description: Canvas rectangle of the moved pixels.

bound.description: Present when the layer became (part of) a part.

merged.description: True when folded into an existing part as a variant.

ambiguous.description: Bones tied for the overlap (nothing bound).

unlinked.description: Other frames whose linked cel now owns the original drawing.

name: pixels_read_grid
title: pixels.readGrid
description:
Read a region (at most 64x64 px) of a frame as a text grid: one symbol per pixel, "." transparent, with a legend of the colours present.

Without "layer" the region is the rendered frame (what pixels.writeGrid edits on a rig frame); with "layer" it is that pixel layer's own cel. Symbols 0-9A-Za-z are assigned in order of first appearance and valid for this call only; at most 62 colours (else read a smaller region). "rulers" adds column and row numbers. Feed `rows` and `legend` back to pixels.writeGrid. Use render_frame to judge looks.

Read-only. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Read the hero head, 8x6 px at (21, 0)): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","animation":{"group":"default"},"frame":0,"x":21,"y":0,"width":8,"height":6}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

layer.description: Read this pixel layer's cel instead of the rendered frame (mirror animations: not allowed).

x.description: Left column of the region, canvas px (default 0).

y.description: Top row of the region, canvas px (default 0).

width.description: Region width, 1..64 px (default: to the right edge, if at most 64).

height.description: Region height, 1..64 px (default: to the bottom edge, if at most 64).

rulers.description: Also return `ruled`: the rows with column and row numbers (default false).

animation.description: "group/direction" of the animation read.

source.description: "render": the rendered frame; "cel": one layer's cel.

x.description: Left column of the region, canvas px.

y.description: Top row of the region, canvas px.

legend.description: Symbol to colour "#rrggbb" ("#rrggbbaa" when translucent), for this call only. "." (transparent) is not listed.

rows.description: One string per pixel row, `width` symbols each.

ruled.description: Only with rulers: two header lines of column numbers, then each row prefixed by its row number.

name: pixels_write_grid
title: pixels.writeGrid
description:
Paint a text grid (at most 32x32 px) at (x, y) of a frame; symbols come from "legend".

"." writes transparent, "_" keeps the pixel. On a rig (part layers) the differences from the rendered frame become overrides (a part override inside one part, else a final one) that survive re-posing (see override.list, `newlyStale`). Otherwise name the pixel `layer` (optional if only one): its cel is rewritten. Palette-locked and indexed documents only take palette colours.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Move the hero's eye one pixel left (an override on the head)): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","animation":{"group":"default"},"frame":0,"x":26,"y":4,"rows":["21"],"legend":{"1":"#e8be96","2":"#1e1e28"}}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

layer.description: Pixel layer whose cel to write. Omit on a rig frame (the rendered frame is edited into overrides), or when the document has exactly one pixel layer.

x.description: Canvas column of the grid's left edge (default 0).

y.description: Canvas row of the grid's top edge (default 0).

rows.description: Pixel rows, at most 32 rows of at most 32 equally long symbols: "." transparent, "_" keep, 0-9A-Za-z from the legend.

legend.description: Symbol (one of 0-9A-Za-z) to colour "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa". Only symbols used in `rows` need an entry.

animation.description: "group/direction" of the animation written.

target.description: "overrides": rig frame, edits stored as overrides; "cel": a pixel layer cel was rewritten.

changed.description: Pixels whose colour changed (0: nothing was written).

layer.description: Name of the layer written; only for target "cel".

overrides.description: Ids of the overrides created, in order; empty unless target is "overrides".

newlyStale.description: Ids of earlier overrides this edit made stale (still applied; re-base or discard them).

name: render_contact_sheet
title: render.contactSheet
description:
Render the frames of some or all animations as one labelled PNG contact sheet (long edge at most 1568 px), optionally with bone lines and pivot markers.

Judge motion across frames (before/after a re-pose, a walk cycle): vision judges gesture and readability, lint owns precision (1 px gaps, off-palette pixels). Tiles are labelled "GROUP/DIRECTION #n" (n = 0-based frame index). The scale is the largest that fits 1568 px, or lower than `scale`. The image is `output.image` (PNG, base64). `bones` draws yellow bone lines and `pivots` red pivot squares (need a rig).

Read-only. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Show every frame of the hero with the skeleton drawn): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","bones":true,"pivots":true}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animations.description: Animations to show, in order (default: all).

items.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

scale.description: Integer upscale to start from, 1..16 (default: the largest that fits 1568 px; reduced until it fits).

skin.description: Skin name or id ("skn_..."); omit for the base render.

bones.description: Draw a line from each bone pivot to its tip on every tile (default false).

pivots.description: Draw a marker on each bone pivot pixel on every tile (default false).

frames.description: Number of frames on the sheet.

data.description: The PNG file, base64 (standard alphabet, padded).

name: render_frame
title: render.frame
description:
Render one frame to an upscaled PNG on a checkerboard (long edge at most 1568 px), optionally with bone lines and pivot markers.

Look at the result of an edit: vision judges gesture, proportions and readability, lint.run owns precision (1 px gaps, off-palette pixels). The image is `output.image` (PNG, base64). `bones` draws a yellow line from each bone pivot to its tip, `pivots` a red square on each snapped pivot pixel (both need a rig; `output.bones` lists the points as numbers). Transparent pixels show a grey checkerboard.

Read-only. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Look at frame 0 of the hero with the skeleton drawn): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","animation":{"group":"default"},"frame":0,"scale":8,"bones":true,"pivots":true}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

scale.description: Integer upscale 1..16 (default and maximum: the largest that keeps the long edge within 1568 px).

skin.description: Skin name or id ("skn_..."); omit for the base render.

bones.description: Draw a line from each bone pivot to its tip (default false).

pivots.description: Draw a marker on each bone pivot pixel (default false).

animation.description: "group/direction" of the rendered animation.

scale.description: The upscale used (may be lower than requested to fit 1568 px).

data.description: The PNG file, base64 (standard alphabet, padded).

bones.description: The overlay bones in canvas pixels; present when bones or pivots was set.

parent.description: Parent bone name; missing for a root bone.

pivot.description: Snapped pivot pixel [x, y], canvas coordinates.

tip.description: Bone tip [x, y]: the pivot plus the bone length along its world direction.

name: rig_apply_template
title: rig.applyTemplate
description:
Apply a humanoid skeleton template: bones matched by name are reused, missing ones are created.

Templates: humanoid-side (view "side"), humanoid-front ("front"), humanoid-back ("back"). With no view a new view is created (named after the template, or viewName); with view the rest pose is set in that view. Creates the rig when the document has none. The template origin is the document origin. Bones that exist with another parent are refused.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Set the rest pose of the hero in its existing side view): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","template":"humanoid-side","view":"side"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

template.description: Skeleton template: humanoid-side, humanoid-front or humanoid-back.

height.description: Character height in px, feet row to top of head (default 48).

view.description: Existing view to set the rest pose in (default: a new view).

viewName.description: Name of the new view (default: the template name, e.g. "side"); ignored with view.

viewId.description: Id of the view the template was applied to.

bones.description: Bone id per template bone name (reused and created).

created.description: Names of the bones that were created.

name: rig_bake
title: rig.bake
description:
Bake a rig animation into one plain pixel layer: as a new animation, or in place.

Renders every frame (parts, overrides, post-passes, exported layers) into a pixel layer "baked" and hides the parts. mode "new" adds animation <group>_baked; "replace" bakes in place. A mirror cannot be baked: bake its source. Pixels no longer follow the rig.

Destructive: pass "confirm": true. Changes the document as one undo step. mode "replace" drops the animation's keys, overrides and post-passes and merges other exported layers (undo restores it); "new" only adds an animation and a layer. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Bake the hero idle as a new animation): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","animation":{"group":"default"},"mode":"new","confirm":true}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

mode.description: "new" keeps the source; "replace" bakes it in place.

name.description: mode "new": group of the baked animation (default <group>_baked).

confirm.description: Must be true: this operation is destructive.

animation.description: Id of the baked animation.

layer.description: Id of the new pixel layer holding the baked pixels.

frames.description: Frame ids of the baked animation, in play order.

cels.description: Cels of other exported pixel layers consumed at the baked frames.

dropped.description: What a "replace" bake removed (all zero for "new").

name: rig_bind_parts
title: rig.bindParts
description:
Bind pixel layers to bones as parts, by layer name ("part:<bone>[.<part>][@variant][#view]") or by overlap.

By name: a layer called part:upper_arm_r (or just a bone name) becomes that bone's part; @variant adds another variant of the same part, #view another view. By overlap: remaining layers bind to the bone their opaque pixels cover, only with a clear winner (ties are listed as ambiguous, nothing is guessed). Layers with several drawings cannot bind (animated). Running it again changes nothing. Cut flat art into layers first with part_split.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Bind every layer named after a bone, no overlap guessing): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","byOverlap":false}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

layers.description: Only these layers (default: every pixel layer).

byOverlap.description: Bind the rest by overlap with the bones (default true).

rawNames.description: Source names to parse instead of layer names, by layer: {"arm": "part:upper_arm_r@open#side"}.

view.description: View for names without #view and for overlap (default: the first).

zByBone.description: Default z of new parts by part-layer name, then bone name; higher draws on top.

merged.description: True when folded into an existing part as a variant.

bound.description: Layers that became (part of) a part.

ambiguous.description: Layers whose overlap has no clear winner (left alone).

skipped.description: Layers left alone, with the reason.

name: rig_edit_bones
title: rig.editBones
description:
Edit the skeleton: add/delete/reparent/rename bones, set length and rest pose per view, add/rename/delete views.

Edits run in order in one undo step; one failure undoes all. Deleting never destroys art: a bone with parts or (without cascade) children is refused. Reparenting keeps the art in place. Rest x/y: root = canvas pivot, child = offset from the parent pivot; angle in deg clockwise relative to the parent. For a standard skeleton use rig_apply_template.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Add a tail bone under the torso, then lengthen the head): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","edits":[{"action":"addBone","name":"tail","parent":"torso","length":8},{"action":"setLength","bone":"head","length":9}]}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

rest.description: Rest pose in one view (without it the bone is unused in every view).

x.description: Root: canvas pivot x. Child: offset x from the parent pivot, int px.

y.description: Root: canvas pivot y. Child: offset y from the parent pivot, int px.

angle.description: Bone direction relative to its parent, deg clockwise (0 = +x, 90 = down).

cascade.description: Also delete all descendants (default: refused when it has children).

parent.description: New parent, or null to make it a root. The art stays put.

x.description: Root: canvas pivot x. Child: offset x from the parent pivot, int px.

y.description: Root: canvas pivot y. Child: offset y from the parent pivot, int px.

angle.description: Bone direction relative to its parent, deg clockwise (0 = +x, 90 = down).

directions.description: Directions it draws (each in one view only).

id.description: Id of the bone or view the edit created.

results.description: One entry per edit, in order.

name: rig_joint_check
title: rig.jointCheck
description:
Sweep each joint of one rig view and report the pixel gaps that open on the outer side of a bend.

Read-only. A rig passes when summary.gapCount is 0. The sweep uses the default range and step. Fix gaps by adjusting the part pivots or overrides, then check again. Checks the view that draws the first direction of the given view (default: the first view).

Read-only. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Check the first view of the hero): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

view.description: Rig view to check (default: the first view).

rangeDeg.description: Sweep range, degrees either side of rest.

radius.description: Window radius of the check, px.

gapCount.description: Gap pixels summed over the sweep.

union.description: Distinct gap pixels over the sweep, sorted by y then x.

joints.description: One entry per joint, sorted by bone name.

name: rig_mirror_animation
title: rig.mirrorAnimation
description:
Add a mirror of an animation under a new direction: same group, flipped around the origin.

The mirror stores no frames or pixels: it plays the source flipped horizontally about the document origin (markers flip too, names stay), so editing the source updates it. Asymmetric art needs a separate animation. The mirror takes the source's group and loop; the direction must be new for that group (I6). A source cannot be a mirror itself. Final overrides of the mirror can be added later with pixels_write_grid on the mirror.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Mirror the hero idle as its left-facing twin): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","source":{"group":"default"},"direction":"left"}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

source.description: The animation to mirror (an authored one, not itself a mirror).

direction.description: Direction of the mirror, e.g. "left" for a "right" source.

animation.description: Id of the new mirror animation.

name: rig_set_pivot
title: rig.setPivot
description:
Set a part variant's pivot: the pixel (int px, in the variant image) that sits on the bone pivot.

Coordinates are in the variant image, origin top-left, pixel centre; the pivot may lie outside the image (a floating hand). Moving the pivot moves the part's art relative to the bone, so run rig_joint_check afterwards. Variant names repeat across views: pass view when the name is ambiguous.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Move the forearm pivot two pixels right): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","part":"lower_arm_r","pivot":{"x":3,"y":1}}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

part.description: Part: its part-layer name (e.g. "head"), part id ("prt_...") or layer id.

view.description: Resolve the variant name among this view's variants.

pivot.description: New pivot, int px in the variant image.

name: rig_set_pose
title: rig.setPose
description:
Set bone keys (angle deg clockwise, offset int px) and/or part keys (variant, z, visible) on one frame.

Keys are sparse and merge: the channels you pass replace the stored ones, the others stay; null removes the whole key of that bone or part on this frame. Angles are relative to the rest pose and compose down the hierarchy. Mirror animations have no frames: pose their source. Check the result with render_frame and rig_joint_check.

Changes the document as one undo step. Conventions: origin top-left, y down, angles in degrees clockwise, integer pixels.

Example (Raise the right arm and bend the elbow on frame 0): {"doc":"doc_g1ed5q","animation":{"group":"default"},"frame":0,"bones":{"upper_arm_r":{"angle":-45},"lower_arm_r":{"angle":-30}}}

doc.description: Document id returned by doc_open or doc_create, e.g. "doc_g1ed5q".

animation.description: Animation: {"group": "run", "direction": "side"} ({"group": "idle"} for an undirected one) or {"id": "anm_..."}.

bones.description: Bone keys by bone name (or id); null removes the key.

angle.description: Rotation from the rest angle, degrees clockwise (child bones follow, FK).

offset.description: Pivot translation from its rest position, integer px.

flipX.description: Mirror the bone horizontally about its pivot.

interp.description: Interpolation from this key to the next: "linear" (default), "step", "ease-in-out".

parts.description: Part keys by part-layer name (or part id); null removes the key.

variant.description: Variant name or id, or "auto" (FR-RIG-14); holds until the next key.

z.description: Draw order override; higher draws on top (default: the view's).

visible.description: Show or hide the part from this frame on.

animation.description: "group/direction" of the posed animation.

changed.description: Keys that changed, as "bones.<name>" / "parts.<name>"; empty when nothing did.
